required_elements: The instrument is a mechanical pencil needing usable lead.
Picking up the eraser means removing it to access the lead-refill opening.
A adds lead so the pencil can write the message.
acceptance: Accept natural paraphrases covering the mechanism without material contradiction. Do not demand incidental hardware or brand details.
player_feedback: Only a binary final verdict; no missing-element feedback.
rejected_attempt: Merely lifting a pencil by its eraser end is insufficient.
